signalAnalysis.description: Point-in-time signal validation. Excess return is realized stock price CAGR minus SPY price CAGR over the same horizon.

portfolioSimulation.description: Annual equal-weight portfolio simulation. At each historical year-end, select the highest-ranked stocks meeting the stated point-in-time Alpha rule, hold for one year, then rebalance. Returns are price-only; transaction costs, taxes and dividends are excluded. Drawdown is measured from year-end portfolio values, not daily lows.
